Interface CartView

All Superinterfaces:
BaseView
All Known Implementing Classes:
SwingStoreView
public interface CartView extends BaseView
View interface for shopping cart operations and display. Extends BaseView to provide cart-specific user interactions including cart menu display and cart content visualization.

      void displayCartMenu()
